title: Sheet Pan Burritos
description: 10 hearty burritos built on a sheet pan — roasted potato/pepper/beef base topped with sheet eggs, cut into squares and rolled with cheddar.

ingredients.text: 8g garlic powder, 8g smoked paprika, 8g cayenne, 30g oil

steps: Chop onions, peppers, potatoes into small pieces; toss in oil, salt; bake sheet pan 200°C/400°F 30 min.
Add raw beef on top; add seasonings; stir; bake 10 more min.
Whisk all eggs; pour over sheet pan; bake 10 more min until egg is set.
Cut into 10 squares. Place each on a tortilla with 15g cheddar; roll into burritos.
Wrap in parchment + foil; freeze up to 3 months. Microwave 5 min from frozen.
macrosNote: Whole recipe (10 burritos). Per burrito: ~541 kcal, 31g protein
notes: Can use turkey instead of beef. Can air-fry from defrosted at 180°C 3–4 min.
